items.text: During three shortage episodes at one teaching hospital between March 2024 and October 2025, what was the rate of substitution-related medication errors per 1,000 doses dispensed of each substituted product, by error type and stage of the medication process?
items.population: Doses of the three substituted products dispensed during each shortage episode
items.outcome: Substitution-related medication errors per 1,000 doses dispensed

finer: Feasible with existing data and 100 resident hours if the privacy office agrees; interesting to the medication safety program; novel locally; ethical with no naming of staff; relevant to the next shortage.
summary: One PECO question on error rates by episode.
